name: What paperwork or considerations are needed for pre-listing improvements?

mainEntity.name: What paperwork or considerations are needed for pre-listing improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting any significant pre-listing improvements, you should consider obtaining any necessary permits for structural, electrical, or plumbing work, especially in areas like Collier or Orange County where regulations can vary. Ensure contractors are licensed and insured, and keep detailed records of all work done, including invoices and warranties. This preparation is vital for transparency with potential buyers and can be an asset during negotiations. Your agent can guide you on specific local requirements and documentation to gather.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather necessary permits for structural or major system work, ensure contractors are licensed, and keep detailed records. This preparation is crucial for transparency with buyers.
